Each playerholds 3 cards and draws after each trick. The trump suit is revealed by the last card dealt, which stays visible until taken. The unusual ranking system (Ace > 3> King > Queen > Jack > 7-2 in point order) makes Briscola distinct from virtually every other card game in the world. Each playerholds 3 cards and draws after each trick. The trump suit is revealed by the last card dealt, which stays visible until taken. The unusual ranking system (Ace > 3> King > Queen > Jack > 7-2 in point order) makes Briscola distinct from virtually every other card game in the world.
